messages:
Alex Chen: Quick FYI — planning to cut release/1.11 on Thu 2026-03-19 18:00 UTC. Cutoff for non-critical changes is Thu 12:00 UTC. Please post any cherry-pick/backport requests here by 11:30 UTC. Only bugfix/security/perf fixes with tests + changelog entry will be accepted after cutoff. :megaphone:

Alex Chen: Branch creation command for the release engineer: `git checkout -b release/1.11.0 origin/main && git push origin release/1.11.0`. Version bump will be applied on the release branch only — do NOT push the bump to main.

Priya Nair: quick q — my refactor in #4321 touches infra helpers, not user-facing. No backport needed, right?

Alex Chen: Not needed unless it's fixing a regression or performance bug. If uncertain, post the commit hash and a short rationale.

Michael O'Leary: Requesting cherry-pick: commit 9f3a2bd — fixes long-tail latency in token batching. Opened PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4872 and added label `backport-request`. CI passed locally.

Elaine Park: Changelog format reminder: one-line bullet in PR description, e.g.:

[serving] Fix long-tail latency in batching (9f3a2bd)

That gets copied into the release notes; please follow this pattern.

devops-bot: Scheduled job: release-artifacts-generator will run 2026-03-19 18:05 UTC. If release/1.11 exists it will gather commits up to the cutoff.

Michael O'Leary: pinging @Alex Chen for cherry-pick approval — CI on the backport PR is green.

Alex Chen: Reviewing now. If CI green + changelog present, we'll merge.

Elaine Park: Note on versioning: package.json and helm chart patch in the release branch should be bumped to 1.11.0. Do not land those bumps to main. Release engineer will open the release PR against release/1.11.

Michael O'Leary: acknowledged, I'll put the bump in the release PR against release/1.11 after cherry-picks are merged.

Priya Nair: docs-only change (tiny wording tweak) — can that land after cutoff? Low risk.

Alex Chen: Docs-only can land to main post-cutoff. If you want it included in the release notes, open a backport but it's optional. Prefer post-cutoff to reduce churn.

Elaine Park: small operational note: when you open a backport PR, please add the following labels: `backport-request`, `release/1.11`, and `changelog-ready`. That speeds up triage.

Michael O'Leary: Added labels to my PR. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Last reminder — post cherry-pick requests here before 11:30 UTC. We'll freeze merges to the release branch 30m before cut for last-minute release engineer checks.

Priya Nair: got it, thanks!

devops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-19 11:00 UTC to heartbeat this thread and list outstanding backport requests.
